mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.1% signals aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates and compressing equity valuation multiples, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.0% triggers aggressive tightening, increasing risk-free rates and reducing equity cash flow present values, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3.0% and housing starts (HOUST) above 950k indicate robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 and HOUST show negative correlation in more than 60% of 3-year windows, or SPX 20-day returns are negative when both series exceed 90th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent UNRATE below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly signal labor market overheating, triggering wage inflation and central bank tightening that reduces equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO decline below 95.0 indicates weakening industrial output, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline is not associated with negative SPX 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.5% YoY signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that reduce equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% YoY for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS rise and CPIAUCSL decline indicate policy pivot to fight inflation, reducing recession risk and boosting equity returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth above 0.3% monthly indicates strengthening retail sales, supporting consumer-driven corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth is not associated with positive SPX 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases over the last 5 years.
